card.name: End of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" inside the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2 or -6. It also fires on a few other word endings inside names, like Tuscany or Pierre-François.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The "in" that completes interleukin right before a hyphenated number.
modes.example: Concurrent administration of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Partway through proper names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a place or person name that is split into parts.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med
